name: session-dock
description: Overview pane for a Claude Code session: model, context, usage, git, and a resettable digest of what happened while you were away. Docks beside the transcript or sits above the prompt.

cardFile.title: Card file
cardFile.description: Markdown card shown on the Card tab, relative to the project root.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often an open pane reloads git and usage.

writeState.description: Write .claude/dock-state.json so the tmux and browser docks can show the same data. Off: nothing is written outside the plugin store.
